text:
maria_support: customer hit a 400 from our /v1/generate call when using JSON mode + function calling. They expect the LLM to return a structured args object but runtime rejected it as schema-mismatch.

alex_prod: can you paste the minimal repro (request + declared function schema)? sdk + region?

maria_support: repro below (redacted api key). Using sdk-js v1.9.2, hosted us-west. Body:
```json
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer ****
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "x-chat-1",
  "mode": "json",
  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "create_order",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "order_ids": { "type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"} },
          "customer_id": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "required": ["order_ids", "customer_id"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Create an order for customer 42 with ids 1234 and 5678"}]
}
```
Runtime response: 400 Bad Request - function args did not match schema: missing required property 'order_ids'

maria_support: Customer's LLM output (what we received as parsed args) was:
```json
{"order_ids": "1234,5678", "customer_id": "42"}
```
(so order_ids was a comma-separated string, not an array)

samir_oncall: saw this earlier too. When agent returns a string instead of array our coercion path tries to coerce comma strings into arrays but only in permissive mode; JSON strict rejects. Also noticed spikes in downstream latency -> retries from client causing multiple tool invokes.

mei_dev: two issues to separate: (1) LLM producing wrong shape (we should log raw assistant content + parsed args), (2) runtime lenient coercion hidden under 'json' mode variants. Suggest we add an opt-in header to enforce strict JSON schema on parse and return a clear 422 with example of expected shape. Quick patch: add check after parsing: if schema says array and parsed value is string containing commas, include hint: "expected array of strings, got comma string e.g. \"1234,5678\"".

alex_prod: can we reproduce locally? Provide a minimal curl that fails for us:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '@payload.json' | jq '.'
```
payload.json = the body above. I can run this.

maria_support: customer also reported intermittent 502s alongside the 400s in the same window (2026-01-12T15:02Z). SRE logs show a slow parse path on one of the routable pods:
```
[svc-inference-07] parse_time_ms=1285 err=null route=dedicated-us-west-2
[svc-inference-07] parse_time_ms=4200 err=json.unmarshal error: invalid JSON token at position 234
[svc-inference-04] parse_time_ms=35 err=null
```

sre-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4521 (auto) - assigned to samir_oncall. :warning:

samir_oncall: I'll triage latency/502 separately. For the schema mismatch, my short-term mitigation is: (A) set default coercion to permissive for customers who opt into legacy behavior, (B) for strict customers return structured validation error with example payload, (C) add a short lived transform that rewrites single-string-of-commas into array for the create_order function only (since it's high-impact).

mei_dev: agree. Also add a prompt-side training note for model onboarding: prefer explicit array formatting in examples. I'll open a PR to add stricter parsing flag header X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict|permissive and a clear error body:
```json
{ "error": "function_args_validation", "message": "order_ids must be array of strings", "example": { "order_ids": ["1234","5678"], "customer_id":"42" } }
```

alex_prod: action items?

maria_support: 1) Provide customer with temporary workaround: use SDK helper to coerce strings -> arrays (I can send snippet). 2) Mei to open PR for header + clearer error (ETA 2d). 3) Samir to investigate 502/latency and whether parse path caused backpressure (ETA EOD). 4) I'll follow up with customer and escalate to account exec if needed.

alex_prod: thanks, please paste any reproducer output here. If we get a failing transcript I can push a hotfix to specially handle comma-delimited order_ids in the parser.

maria_support: will paste CLI output after I run with customer dataset. For now customer accepted the workaround.
